messages:
Maya Chen: Quick UX review for model catalog presets + keyboard/a11y pass. Uploading screens: https://redwood.share/s/xyz :eyes:
Maya Chen: Main asks: save filter presets (persist across sessions), keyboard nav in compare table, perf badge tooltip microcopy, version-pin modal copy + undo flow.
Ethan Cole: Saw the screens, looks good. For presets, prefer the label 'Save view as preset' over 'Save filter' — clearer for users who expect layout too.
Ethan Cole: Also propose an inline preset chip that shows current preset with a small chevron for switching.
Alex Rivera: Frontend note: we should map presets to URL params so teams can link directly (e.g., ?preset=team-qa). That keeps shareability.
Alex Rivera: Keyboard shortcuts suggestion: '/' to focus global filter, 'j/k' to move rows, '←/→' for paging, 'space' to toggle select/compare. Example hint: 
```
/ focus
j/k row nav
space toggle compare
```
Linda Park: A11y: ensure focus indicators are high-contrast (2px is fine) and visible for keyboard users. Chips need 3:1 contrast vs bg; critical text (badges) should be 4.5:1.
Linda Park: For screen readers, announce 'Preset selected: <name>' and when entering compare mode announce via aria-live 'Comparison mode: 2 models selected'.
Maya Chen: Perf badge microcopy — current is just an icon + color. Proposed copy: 'Latency · p50 35ms · p95 120ms · Cost 0.8x' short and machine-readable in tooltip.
Ethan Cole: I like short form. Also add a pattern (dot+stripe) in badge to signal perf tiers for colorblind folks.
Alex Rivera: Patterned SVG is doable; fallback to text label for older browsers. Implementation impact: small, but need SVG assets + CSS tokens.
Linda Park: Tooltip must be a proper accessible tooltip (role=tooltip, aria-describedby) and includable in keyboard flow. Do not rely on color alone.
Maya Chen: Version pinning: modal currently says 'Are you sure?'. Tone is scary. Suggest: 'Pin this version to route production traffic to this model variant. You can unpin later.' Add a secondary 'Notify team' checkbox default off.
Ethan Cole: Also show a small diff summary in modal: model hash, quantization, and last deploy time. Helps SRE/product decide quickly.
Alex Rivera: Can do. Also propose an undo snackbar after pin with 'Unpin' action for 30s. Saves support tickets.
Linda Park: Accessibility nit for modal: set focus to primary action, trap focus, and return focus to the pin button after close. Add aria-live message for success/failure states.
Maya Chen: UX nit: keyboard hint overlay on mock overlaps pagination at smaller widths. Move the hint to top-left or collapse to a single-line icon.
Ethan Cole: +1 move to top-left. Also maybe hide hint under ?help for very small screens.
Alex Rivera: I can prototype variant with top-left hint + responsive collapse. Estimated 2 dev days for initial implementation + 1 day for a11y fixes.
Linda Park: Quick PR checklist to include: focus order verification, aria-live region for compare changes, skip-to-filters link, contrast checks for badges, and screenreader announcements for presets.
Maya Chen: Great. I'll update Figma with preset chip, badge pattern, updated modal copy, and add the keyboard overlay in the component lib. Scheduling follow-up review Thu 10am. If no objections I'll push the figma updates tonight.
Ethan Cole: 👍
Alex Rivera: 🚀
Linda Park: 👀
design-bot: Screenshot updated (v3) with preset chip + keyboard hint — https://redwood.files/v3/preset-chip.png
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone — will post PR once assets are in design system.
